recognize_zh: 胸部電腦斷層（CT）橫切面上，左前胸壁與腋下有一個巨大、以軟組織密度為主的腫塊，向外隆起並延伸至左側腋窩，內部密度不均、有較低密度區（可能為壞死或感染）；巨大快速長大的軟組織腫塊符合難治性高惡度 B 細胞淋巴瘤（double-hit）的影像表現。
features: Axial CT of the upper chest at the level of the aortic arch/great vessels
Very large soft-tissue attenuation mass of the left anterior chest wall bulging the skin contour
Mass extends posterolaterally into the left axilla with heterogeneous lower-attenuation areas
Mass abuts the anterior chest wall; lungs and mediastinal vessels on this slice without obvious invasion
Non-morphologic image; tissue diagnosis cannot be made from imaging
describe_en: Axial CT image of the upper chest shows a very large, predominantly homogeneous soft-tissue mass arising in the left anterior chest wall and extending into the left axilla, with heterogeneous lower-attenuation areas in its posterolateral portion that may represent necrosis or infection. The mass deforms the overlying skin contour and abuts the anterior chest wall; the lungs and mediastinal vessels at this level appear intact. Extension into the neck and possible vascular or thyroid invasion described clinically are not shown on this slice. The imaging findings of a bulky, necrotic soft-tissue mass are compatible with refractory high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, which requires tissue diagnosis for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Soft tissue sarcoma of the chest wall
ddx.vs: Imaging cannot reliably distinguish; biopsy showing a CD20+ large B-cell population with MYC/BCL2 rearrangement by FISH establishes lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g., breast) to axillary nodes/chest wall
ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells on biopsy; imaging features overlap.
Abscess shows a rim-enhancing fluid collection with gas or clinical sepsis, whereas this mass is predominantly solid.
